verdict: Spend is running normally, but lead capture has stopped completely.
narrative: Over the last 7 days, you received zero leads despite $495 in ad spend — this is not a drop in demand for your services, it is a broken connection between your ads and your lead tracking. Google Ads' primary campaign has consumed $1,699 of the 28-day budget and was recording conversions earlier in the period, but nothing is being captured now, pointing to a conversion tracking or contact form issue. Separately, your CRM shows 62 opportunities created this period but zero appointments booked, which suggests incoming leads may not be reaching the right person in time. We are actively diagnosing both the tracking failure and the intake routing to restore visibility and follow-up speed. Once the tracking is repaired, this period's numbers will under-report actual activity — expect a corrected read next week.
